notes.title: Release QoL Patch
notes.content:
After seeing a few people play, I wanted to make this patch to make things a little more enjoyable:

- Passive abilities show up next to your other abilities, so you can remind yourself of how they work.
- Buying a rank of a perk automatically equips it so you don't forget to equip it.
- Fixed a bug where trying to use a controller would make your targeting reticle disappear until restart.

Hope you continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: RUNNING RIOT RELEASED!
notes.content: [p]After 5 long years of development, what started as a MOBA about zombies has finally released on Steam as Running Riot! I hope you all enjoy playing this game as much as I do, and I thank you for being part of the community. I eagerly await your reactions, and I hope you have a RIOT![/p]

notes.title: Here Comes the Boom!
notes.content: [p]Welcome to the final character of Running Riot: BOOMER. Boomer brings an area control playstyle and tons of explosives. His kit, upgrades, perks, and combos are now all live. Hope you like him as much as I do! He's such a grumpy lookin lil guy.[/p]

notes.title: Bring the Thunder
notes.content: [p]Tempest is now ready to destroy enemies! Come check out his full kit, upgrades, and perks. Tempest is a bit of a wild character, so I expect some tuning is in order. In any case, I hope you like him![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43696499/d2fd26d9583f0156c42e2c6cb12a51cb9742a797.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Edge of Glory
notes.content: [p]Edge is now live with her revamped kit, upgrades, and perks. I hope you like her gameplay, it's definitely going to keep you on your toes. As always, I'm looking forward to hearing your feedback on how she can be improved![/p]

notes.title: Impulse is Here!
notes.content: [p]Impulse has arrived. Check out his hyper risky kit, perks, upgrades, and combos now! With the launch on the horizon, I'm looking forward to hearing your experience with Impulse so he can get tuned to perfection. Enjoy the riot![/p]

notes.title: Boomer Testing
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43696499/6c5cfdbd08202d070c9ef1d606913328e78c3cdf.png"][/img][/p][p]Boomer is ready to riot with an arsenal of explosive abilities! While his perks and upgrades are still in development, you can try his kit out now. Looking forward to hearing your feedback on this tough lil guy.[/p]

notes.title: Impulse Testing
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43696499/274c3b2560b6ef716716cefae2747ef1d0d44cd2.png"][/img][/p][p]Introducing Impulse! notes.title: v0.23.0 - Quality of Life
notes.content:
It's my birthday and so I've got a birthday update full of quality of life improvements and tuning. Along with some bugfixes, this patch focuses on tuning each character's numbers a bit to make them more consistent and enjoyable, namely:

- Commando's upgrades seemed to vary wildly in terms of power. This update makes her upgrades more comparable, so that your choices can make more of an impact.
- Edge was fun, but a little hard to control. These number changes should make her easier to handle and more fair.
- Tempest wasn't able to compete at the same level as the other characters. This update should give Tempest some more survivability and killing power.

In addition, this patch adds a UI rework to make things cleaner and easier to read, hope you like it!

notes.title: v0.22.1
notes.content: - Removed the teleport that happens after you finish the Payload mission, as it was crashing the game. I'll find a better way to transition you between rooms in the future.

notes.title: v0.22.0 - New Ability Kits!
notes.content:
Hey there Runners, I've got a huge update to share:

[list]
[*] Revamped kits: Each character is having their kit revamped to give you more options, more build paths, and hopefully more fun. New kits means new upgrades and new perks.

[*] Instead of gaining XP automatically from killing enemies, now you'll have to pick up XP orbs that they drop on death. XP orbs disappear after a while, so you'll need to scoop up what you can. It's my hope that the risk of collecting XP will bring some more intensity and variety to your runs.

[*] Enemies will now sometimes drop power-ups when they die. Pick one up before it disappears and you'll get a cool bonus!

[*] Fixing a few bugs here and there, as well as some quality of life improvements that I hope make things more smooth.

[/list]

Free demo players will see the changes for Commando, but only people who own the full game will see the updates to Edge and Tempest!

I can't wait to hear what you think of the changes, your feedback goes a long way towards making this game better.

notes.title: v0.21.0 - Running Riot is Back!
notes.content:
It's been a busy time, but I'm glad to say that I'm back to working on [b]Running Riot[/b]! We're switching into a content and tuning mode now, as the vision for the game is basically there. Right now, I'm just trying to play the game a ton and hear what you have to say about how it could be better. I'm looking forward to implementing changes based on your feedback, and I expect to be posting regular updates.

Thanks to everybody who has checked out the game so far, and I hope that more players will join us soon! As always, the Discord is open to chat about the game!

notes.title: v0.20.0 - New Tempest Class & Controller Support
notes.content:
- A new class is out: Tempest! This hulking brawler is ready to strike with his huge hammer and electrifying lightning.
- Basic controller support. This is a first iteration that I'm hoping to iterate on based on your feedback! NOTE: The Settings Menu does not currently support the controller, please use your mouse while I rework the Settings Menu.

notes.title: v0.19.0 - Edge Perks
notes.content:
- Edge meta-progression perks are now available!
- Some buffs to Edge to make her more viable.
- Some nerfs to Commando to make her more challenging.

notes.title: v0.18.2 - Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
- Fixed a couple of buggy Commando perks.
- You can now equip up to 2 perks in each tier.
- Edge now has invulnerability during Vault.
- Edge's Circular Slash has its windup time removed, hopefully it should feel more responsive.

notes.title: Introducing Meta-Progression & a New Class!
notes.content:
v0.18.0 - Commando Perks and the Edge Class

It's been awesome watching you players [b]run[/b] and [b]riot[/b] and [b]run riot[/b], but it's clear that you need more options. So I've been hard at work on a couple of exciting updates that are ready for you to try!

First up is the introduction of [u][b]Meta-Progression[/b][/u]. After every Running Riot run, whether you win or lose, you'll be rewarded with RR [b]Tickets[/b]. You can then spend those RR Tickets on Meta-Progression goodies. This update introduces the first kind of Meta-Progression: [b]Class Perks[/b]. If you go to the Classes menu and select Commando, you can click the "View Perks" button to spend your tickets on bonuses. These bonuses will apply to you at the start of every run. Right now it's just Commando who has Perks, but more are on the way.

You'll also notice that there's a new class: [u][b]Edge[/b][/u]! Edge is a hyper-mobile swordmaster who dashes around the map, slicing and dicing enemies. She definitely plays differently from Commando, and she's got her own set of abilities and upgrades to explore. I hope you like her, and we'll work together to polish her mechanics!

I hope you enjoy these new features. Be sure to drop a comment in the Community Hub if you've got something you'd like to discuss!

- Evan Martinez

notes.title: First Update is In Development!
notes.content:
This weekend, I've been taking a [u]much-needed[/u] break away from the computer. I told myself, [b]NO CODING[/b], and my wrists have thanked me for it. However, the weekend is almost over, which means I can [i]finally[/i] get back to Running Riot development.

Thanks to your great outpouring of feedback, it's clear what's on the list of the most important things that Running Riot needs. I wish that I could work on everything all at once, but I've gotta start somewhere. Therefore, my first two initiatives (in addition to general bug fixes and polish) are:

[list]
[*] Implementing [b]meta-progression[/b]
[*] Making the game more [b]challenging[/b]
[/list]

These two initiatives go hand in hand. I want Running Riot to be the sort of game that you want to explore. When you're not busy blasting away CyberPunks, I'd like you to be [i]thinking[/i] about new ways to blast away CyberPunks! I think that making the game more challenging will incentivize players to experiment with playstyles to find what works best for them. On the flip side, meta-progression will give players that sort of freedom to discover how they like to play.

Even though I haven't been coding this weekend, I have been doing plenty of design work that's ready to be added [b]ASAP[/b]. The game might get a little volatile as we find and fix balance issues, but that's the fun of early access!

I am incredibly humbled by the positive response to Running Riot. It's so cool to see players doing things in the game that I never anticipated. I'll continue poring over feedback from playtesting sessions, reviews, and YouTube videos to better understand what you all like and dislike, and I think we've got a great road ahead of us.

Love,
Evan Martinez

notes.title: v0.17.1 - Infinite XP Bug
notes.content: - Fixed a bug in Room 5 (Wrecking Ball) where you could get infinite XP. Sorry, but it can't be that easy!

notes.title: Running Riot on Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Early Access![/h1]

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for checking out Running Riot. I'm so happy that we're out in Early Access, and I'm ready to get started on all sorts of new content!

The current build has 1 class and 8 rooms that are always in the same order. But don't worry, that's going to change really soon. Along with addressing balance/gameplay issues with you all, I'll also be actively developing new classes, rooms, upgrades, everything!

So again, thanks for being here. I hope you'll use the community space for discussions on how things can be made better, and I'm eager to hear what you think.

I've also got a [url=https://discord.gg/gT3MZgJe8z]Discord[/url] set up for more conversations, live development, playtesting, and just playing games in general.

Let's Run Riot!
- Evan Martinez, Party Moose Games
